textos.Lançado em 2002 e dirigido por Steven Sp: Released in 2002 and directed by Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can is a film that combines drama and crime based on real events. The plot follows Frank Abagnale Jr., a young man who masters the art of disguise and pulls off million-dollar scams by posing as practitioners of various professions, while being pursued by a certain FBI agent.
textos.A experiência se constrói a partir de um: The experience is built on a long running time and a structure geared toward a constant chase dynamic between the characters.
textos.De maneira geral, os diferentes grupos a: Overall, the different groups analyze the same central elements of the production and agree on what the film is, diverging mainly in their verdict on how well those points work. Among the vast majority of ratings (~87%), most emphasize the charisma and interplay of Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hanks working together. In addition, a significant share praises Spielberg's direction, while many value the cat-and-mouse dynamic established between the leads.
textos.Para quem se situa nessa faixa intermedi: For those in this middle band, corresponding to a minimal fraction of ratings (~11%), a good portion express distrust about the truthfulness of the true story, judging the account exaggerated. In this group, several note discomfort with the pacing and long running time, although a considerable number maintain favorable assessments of the cast's performances.
textos.Sob a perspectiva dos que integram uma f: From the perspective of those making up an even smaller fraction of ratings (~1%), about half disapprove of the excessive length and the dragging pace of the narrative.
